나. 교과목 소개


 - 마케팅론/Marketing principle

Classes are taught 100% in English. You will study "Marketing and yourself " with Amy Ko ( Ko Myung Ae) , a Korean-American professor. You will learn about the importance, history, and current trends in marketing and enjoy a diverse classroom environment with other international students. You will also have the opportunity to go on a field trip during the semester to broaden your experience and learning. Classes will be lively and fun, including open discussions and presentations.

 

 - 국제마케팅/International Marketing

You'll learn international marketing in a classroom environment where you'll interact with students dynamically from all over the world. You will have better understanding about different culture and the global marketing environment. You will have the opportunity to take part in field trips during the semester to further expand your experience. This course is highly recommended for students who plan to continue studying and working in Korea. Classes are taught 100% in English with Amy Ko( Ko Myung Ae), a Korean-American professor.
